_comment: Copy to ~/picarx-mcp/voice_config.json ON THE ROBOT (not on the laptop, not in the repo): it holds your ElevenLabs key. Read by robot_say*.py, robot_hear.py, robot_listen_loop.py, doa.py and friends.

tts.voice_id: PLACEHOLDER — your Claude's ElevenLabs voice id

_comment_language: Speech language: set tts.language_code and stt.language_code (e.g. "hu"), and ROBOT_ESPEAK_VOICE for the offline espeak fallback voice (default "en").
